samples.name: Basic Editing
samples.description: This demo shows how to render the Rich Text Editor UI component with a minimum configuration setting.

samples.name: Full-Featured Editing
samples.description: This demo shows how to render the Rich Text Editor UI component with a minimum configuration setting.

samples.name: Inline Editing
samples.description: An inline Rich Text Editor UI sample configured for in-place editing with a compact toolbar.

samples.name: Toolbar
samples.description: This demo shows how to configure the toolbar type and position of the Rich Text Editor UI component.

samples.name: Slash Commands
samples.description: This demo shows how to enable the Slash Commands feature in the Rich Text Editor UI component, which lets users open a command palette by typing "/" to quickly insert and format content.

samples.name: Properties
samples.description: This demo shows how to render the Rich Text Editor UI component with a minimum configuration setting.

samples.name: Methods
samples.description: This demo shows how to programmatically interact with the Rich Text Editor UI component using its public methods such as getHtml, getText, getSelection, selectAll, focus, blur, save, updateToolbarItems and the commands() helper.

samples.name: Events
samples.description: This demo explains client-side events of Rich Text Editor UI that is triggered on editing and formatting operations with an event tracer.

samples.name: Email Composer
samples.description: This demo showcases a Email Composer built with Rich Text Editor UI. It allows users to select recipients using MultiSelect components, enter a subject, compose rich email content with formatting tools, insert links, images, and tables, use Slash Commands for quick content creation, and simulate Send and Save Draft actions using the editor content and recipient information.

samples.name: Forum Post Editor
samples.description: This demo shows a forum discussion component with Rich Text Editor UI integrated, allowing users to create, view, copy, and delete comments with avatars and timestamps.

samples.name: HTML Preview
samples.description: The online HTML editor is a demo that provides LIVE experience for both content and HTML editing with Rich Text Editor features in a real-world scenario.

samples.name: Editor in Dialog
samples.description: This demo showcases the Rich Text Editor UI component integrated inside a Dialog component, allowing users to compose formatted messages in a modal dialog with send and cancel buttons.

samples.name: Chat UI
samples.description: This demo demonstrates Chat UI integration with Rich Text Editor UI for composing and sending rich messages.

samples.name: Tab
samples.description: This demo shows a tab component with Rich Text Editor UI.
